name: GitHub Enterprise (IBM)
tagline: IBM's internal GitHub Enterprise MCP server, authenticated with a personal access token.
description: IBM's GitHub Enterprise instance exposes a remote MCP server at api.github.ibm.com. Authenticate with a personal access token created on github.ibm.com.

methods.label: Personal access token
methods.note: Create a PAT on your IBM GitHub Enterprise instance and pass it as a Bearer token.

auth.guide:
**Personal access token:** create one under [Settings → Developer settings → Personal access tokens](https://github.ibm.com/settings/tokens) on your IBM GitHub Enterprise instance.

Point your MCP client at `https://api.github.ibm.com/mcp` and set the auth header:

```
Authorization: Bearer <your-pat>
```

sources.title: GitHub Enterprise Server — creating a personal access token

interfaces.name: GitHub IBM MCP Server
interfaces.note: IBM internal GitHub Enterprise MCP endpoint. Requires a PAT from github.ibm.com/settings/tokens.
